subject: E-1248: upload stalls on Windows
body:
Hi, I'm using SyncVault 4.2.3 on Windows 11 24H2. Whenever I upload a file since Tuesday, the app
shows 'E-1248: upload stalled at 0 bytes/s'.

The machine's power profile was switched to the battery-saver preset. Uploads stall as soon as the
screen turns off.

I've already tried restarting the machine, which changed nothing.

Thanks, Aisha Bello (Caldera Foods)
